MATCH (t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH t, c, collect(o.name) AS owners
WHERE (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND NOT ('Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall' IN owners))
   OR (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967 AND 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' IN owners)
RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
